Posted November 3, 2004
Analysis by Richard Cowan Sponsored by Advanced Nutrients.
See
 Barbarism In New Zealand: Lies Have Consequences. Severely Handicapped Man Faces Prison for Growing Seven Plants!

Yesterday, in New Zealand, Christchurch District Court Judge David Holderness sentenced Neville Yates, a wheelchair-bound and brain-damaged medical cannabis patient to prison for five months for growing his own medicine. The ignorant and arrogant judge actually had the audacity to tell him, If you had pleaded guilty promptly, the sentence was likely to have been no more than three months jail.

Yates's family fears for his safety in prison, because while he was in prison for cannabis cultivation in 1999, he was bullied and beaten up by other prisoners, who stole his food and even his prosthetic leg!

In other words, a law enforcement system that cannot protect a cripple in prison pretends that it is serving justice by attacking cripples for growing a plant. It is particularly despicable that this outrage happened in a town called Christchurch. Jesus wept!

Meanwhile, Jim Anderton, New Zealand's Associate Minister of Health says he will not support a bill allowing the cultivation of medical cannabis.

He told New Zealand National Radio, The Ministry of Health is looking into this issue but it has to do it on a careful basis. It has to have clinical evidence and advice that using cannabis for pain relief is safe
See
 Bush's New Freedom Initiative: Treatment For Using Cannabis, From The Wonderful Folks Who Brought Us Vioxx, Baycol, Etc. Author of IOM Report Says, " I can't understand why it isn't rescheduled. "
and
 No, Cannabis Will Not Be The 21st Century Aspirin Because It Doesn't Kill Anyone! People Suffer And Die, While Scientists Try To Pharmaceuticalize The Aspirin Of the 21st Century B.C.

Anderton said the effects of smoking cannabis were even worse than tobacco.
See
 British Lung Foundation Cons Media. Blaming Cannabis for Problems Caused By Prohibition. Tripping Over the Party Line. The Media Fell For It, As Usual, But UK Anti-Tobacco Group Does Not.

To complete the demonstration of his ignorance he added if cannabis were available in less dangerous forms than smoking and was proved to work medically he would not have a problem with it. Obviously, he has not heard about vaporization, nor about the US Drug Czar's own Institute of Medicine report.

Meanwhile in Canada, Ann McLellan, the Public Safety Minister and former Health Minister was quoted as saying that the jury's still out on the medical value of cannabis. Of course, the Canadian government like DEAland's is blocking research on the medical use of cannabis.

The message, whether it's from me, whether it's from the minister of justice, the minister of health, is that marijuana continues to be illegal in this country, and you're pretty stupid, in most cases, if you smoke it, McLellan said.
